messages:
maria: quick sync — vendor just confirmed a PARTIAL shipment for Dedicated batch A, outbound Fri morning. need to lock a few things quickly:
• is procurement ETA still Fri->site Mon window? (vendor said '48-72h in transit')
• are reservation IDs pinned to customers? I have `RES-A4872` and `RES-A4873` listed but not sure if allocations are final
• who owns cluster readiness checklist (cabling, PDU labeling, firmware bump)? @sam @jon @claire please chime

sam: got it. carrier picked it up today, tracking shows in-transit. ETA to our staging DC Mon 09:00 PT. cable kits and trays ship with the boxes but we should expect some partial kits (vendor callout).

jon: allocations: I just confirmed `RES-A4872` -> dedicated-pool-east-01 is pinned, `RES-A4873` still unpinned (pending billing commit). If finance approves the invoice by EOD we can finalize. Anyone on finance ping me.

claire: SRE pre-checks: power circuit sign-off is green for east-01, but we need final rack PDUs labeled and power-cycling steps validated. I can run smoke tests Tue 11:00 PT once racks are live. also, request we do a firmware bump to 55.2 before we join them to clusters — has to be coordinated w/ infra.

maria: thanks. action items so far:
- @jon: finalize RES-A4873 pin after finance approval (blocker)
- @sam: validate cable-kit manifest on arrival and log any missing parts to the vendor portal (screenshot + order id)
- @claire: schedule smoke + firmware bump Tue 11:00 PT, share short runbook here

sam: will do. note: carrier said one crate has a damaged corner, might be fine but we'll mark "inspect-upon-arrival" and escalate if PSU rails bent. i'll take photos and open vendor claim if needed.

jon: finance asked for the updated PO number — PO-99221. I pinged @finance. once they ack we'll call the pin API: `POST /api/reservations/pin` with body `{ "reservation": "RES-A4873", "pool": "dedicated-pool-east-01" }`

claire: runbook stub here:
```
- receive crate -> inspect outer packaging
- verify serials against manifest (CSV)
- attach PDU labels (labeling kit in box 3)
- apply firmware 55.2 via usb image
- join to staging cluster with isolation vlan
- run smoke tests: https://internal/runbooks/dedicated-smoke
```
I'll paste the final one after Tue testing.

maria: perfect. one small dependency: network team needs BGP session pre-configured for the isolation VLAN. @network oncall can someone confirm that BGP peerings are staged?

deploy-bot: scheduled: canary smoke-run reserved for Tue 11:30 PT (window 30m). tag: dedicated-batch-a-canary

sam: raising a small ops note — if PSU rails or rails screws missing we have a fallback: we can temp-mount to spare sleds in staging for smoke, but that increases handling time. will call it out in arrival report.

maria: thanks all. i'll follow up with a short checklist email to stakeholders once RES-A4873 is pinned. if anything else pops up, drop it here. :thumbsup:
